name: Ironband's Compound
summary: Dark Iron dwarves hold Ironband's Compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. Once Sturgy Ironband's camp, it now threatens travelers and nearby settlements.

sections.title: A Fall to the Dark Irons
sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves hold the compound south of Helm's Bed Lake. Sturgy Ironband first established the camp as a staging post in Dun Morogh's snowy wilderness. Dark Iron infiltrators pushed deep into Bronzebeard territory and seized it. Now their forces threaten travelers and nearby settlements, close to Ironforge.

sections.title: A Threat to Ironforge
sections.body: The Dark Iron camp stands within Dun Morogh's borders, a serious provocation to Ironforge. The city keeps watch and sends seasoned warriors to recover fallen scouts and secure vital intelligence about the Dark Iron threat in the mountain kingdom.

faq.answer: Sturgy Ironband once inhabited and used the outpost before hostile forces drove him out and seized it.
Hostile Dark Iron dwarves control the camp and attack wanderers or Ironforge patrols that approach.
You can find the compound in eastern Dun Morogh's snowy hills, south of Helm's Bed Lake.

faq.q: Why is this camp important to the leaders of Ironforge?
faq.answer: An enemy clan has fortified a base close to Ironforge, raising alarm over the city's security. Ironforge authorities send fighters to gather evidence of Dark Iron infiltration.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard, you see the Dark Irons' entrenchment within Dun Morogh as an insult and a continuing danger to your homeland.
As a warrior, you are sent here by Ironforge's veteran trainers to aid fallen comrades and gather proof of the Dark Iron presence.
